bloques.titulo: Strict consistency of the transient verb
texto: The verb never remains arbitrarily in singular if the following name is plural: **Qui si parlano quattro lingue** (Here four languages are spoken).

filas: You're looking for a bilingual secretary.

frases.it: Guarda questo cartello in vetrina: «Qui si vendono libri usati».
frases.es: Mira este cartel en el escaparate: «Aquí se venden libros usados».
frases.en: Look at this sign in the window: «Here you sell used books».

frases.it: Che bella libreria! E accanto c'è scritto che si affittano due camere per studenti.
frases.es: ¡Qué bonita librería! Y al lado pone que se alquilan dos habitaciones para estudiantes.
frases.en: What a nice bookstore! And next to it, it says that two rooms are rented for students.

frases.it: In quest'agenzia invece si cerca una guida turistica per il museo.
frases.es: En esta agencia en cambio se busca un guía turístico para el museo.
frases.en: In this agency instead a tourist guide for the museum is sought.

frases.it: Ottimo, così si offrono opportunità concrete ai giovani della città.
frases.es: Estupendo, así se ofrecen oportunidades concretas a los jóvenes de la ciudad.
frases.en: This is a great way of offering concrete opportunities to the young people of the city.

bloques.pregunta: Why is «si vendono» used instead of «si vende» to «libri usati»?

opciones.texto: Porque el sustantivo receptor «libri usati» es plural y exige la concordancia pasivante del verbo.
opciones.explicacion: «si passivante» rule with transient verb and patient plural subject.

opciones.texto: Porque «libri» es un sustantivo irregular que rechaza el singular.
opciones.explicacion: False: there is regular singular «il libro».

opciones.texto: Because the implicit subject is the booksellers who work in the store.
opciones.explicacion: In passive construction with «si» the grammatical patient rules the verb.

bloques.frase: In questa libreria storica ___ molti romanzi classici.

opciones.explicacion: Concords in plural with the patient subject postponed «molti romanzi».

bloques.frase: Si affittano due camere arredate vicino all'università.

opciones.texto: Two furnished rooms are offered on a rental basis next to the university.
opciones.explicacion: Accurate contextual translation of the passivant plural.

opciones.texto: A student is looking for partners to share an empty floor.
opciones.explicacion: Distorts the offer of rooms for rent.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right form for a singular element like «una casa»?

opciones.texto: Si vende una casa in collina.
opciones.explicacion: Third person singular agreed with the «una casa» noun.

opciones.texto: Si vendono una casa in collina.
opciones.explicacion: Number discord between plural verb and singular subject.

opciones.texto: Vende si una casa in collina.
opciones.explicacion: Agrammatical position of the clic particle «si».

bloques.explicacion: It orders the elements of plural passivant construction.

bloques.frase: All'ufficio del turismo ___ informazioni in diverse lingue.

intro: When the **si** particle accompanies a transient verb that has an explicit direct object, the construction adopts passive value (**si passivante**). The verb must be consistent in number (singular or plural) with that object, which assumes the role of grammatical subject.
